status: x-y-time-only same-night feasibility preflight frozen before comparative vertical outcomes
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism discrimination; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims
question: Can the five comparative panels test whether same-individual history predicts vertical organization better than contemporaneous other bats sharing the same night?

night_definition.rule: UTC timestamp shifted backward by 12 hours, then calendar date
night_definition.rationale: keeps evening-to-next-morning nocturnal tracking in one start-night bin
night_definition.session_night: dominant shifted-night among state-valid endpoints in the frozen session

kinematic_state.source: frozen speed2_turn2 definition selected before vertical outcome

feasibility.self_history: other retained sessions of the same individual within the same frozen cohort
feasibility.same_night_other: retained sessions assigned to the same shifted night but belonging to other individuals in the same cohort
feasibility.target_support: target kinematic endpoint whose 5-km cell × state stratum appears in at least one self-history session and in at least one same-night-other session
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one target session with >=50 supported endpoints, >=1 self-history session, and >=1 same-night other individual
feasibility.panel_gate: retain at least 70% of the kinematic-state baseline evaluable n and at least 5 individuals in every panel
feasibility.decision: If all five panels pass, freeze exact evaluable n and open the vertical outcome. Otherwise stop this five-panel night-context family.

planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.response: session-centered residual height using the frozen 10 residual-height bins
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.self_predictor: equal-session P(z_residual | 5-km cell, speed×turn state) from the same individual's other sessions
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.contemporaneous_predictor: equal-individual P(z_residual | 5-km cell, speed×turn state) from other individuals on the target shifted night
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.endpoint: mean target log P_self - log P_same_night_other on common supported target endpoints
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.aggregation: equal target session within individual, then equal individual within panel
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.null: within each frozen cohort, permute whole-session individual labels while preserving the exact session-count multiset; shifted-night, x-y-time state and centered within-session data stay attached to each session block; rebuild both predictors and the complete endpoint
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.panel_pass_rule: exact frozen preflight n; observed-minus-null-mean self-vs-same-night gain > 0; one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 4 or 5 panels PASS => shared calendar-night context is insufficient as a general explanation; 2 or 3 => mixed; 0 or 1 => shared night context may explain much of the signal, subject to support/power.

claim_boundary: Calendar-night matching controls shared broad temporal context, not measured wind, temperature or uplift at each fix.
Same-night persistence does not prove intrinsic morphology, memory or personality.
A failure can reflect limited same-night overlap and is not itself proof of environmental causation.
This extension remains outside the frozen v0.3.8 submission package.
stop_rule: Do not change shifted-night definition, 0.95 purity, speed×turn state definition, 50-event support, 70% panel retention, >=5 floor, panel set, permutation counts/seeds or pass rules after preflight/output.
Do not substitute a looser night definition or drop a panel if the preflight fails.
Do not inspect vertical outcomes before the preflight gate passes and exact n is frozen.
